Definition: Jerimoth or Jeremoth, the name of twelve Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Jerimoth is the name of twelve Israelites, musicians, soldiers and Levites among them. In 1 Chronicles 7:7, Jerimoth, and Iri. The fuller story is told on the Jerimoth, Son of Bela profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Jerimoth matters because God works through ordinary people, and no name in His book is there by accident.
